title: bn254-gt-dlp: Pure-Integer C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS with Band-3 tau-Orbit 12D Lattice Bucket-Sieve + Band-2 SB-enter x4: 2^85.450205160

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained pure-integer baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A (6,2) C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS of proof.md (pure-product s=0.80 kap=0.0 collection: Band 1 [2^14,2^41.5) at 898/256 Ir/hit; hybrid 2-pass x4 / 1-pass chained head[sb]+next[ai] Band 2 [2^41.5,2^54.5) with the Band-2 SB-enter x4 unroll C_SB_ENTER_LL_SLOPE 3.50->3.00; pure-integer Band-3 tau-orbit 12D lattice bucket-sieve [2^54.5,2^60.0) at C_LBS=80.75 Ir/hit combining Tier-1 threshold-pivoted SHIFT=24 + umulh + Q48 k=1 finite-difference + 128.5KiB SQRT16 3-bound Cholesky at 80.75 Ir/hit with the Tier-2 fallback REMOVED (gate-failing orbits aborted; the p_fb<=0.005 hit-weighted premise is charged as a RELATION-CONDITIONED loss: the package's retention model gives E[k_B3]=2.1999 Band-3 factors per usable g-norm with phi_max=26.88771383465995, so the union bound phi_max*p_fb*ln(60/54.5)=0.0129254430 (no independence assumed; the b3_skip=0.0129254430 is also passed into evaluate_descent miss_side for every largest-factor bin at b>=55) multiplies each g-side retention by 1-0.0129254430, raising V to 2^96.5876, so C_LBS is Tier-1 only 80.75 Ir/hit), flat padded canon_a/table_b, and 4KiB page-linked super-buckets, lifting the base retention to 0.999624 (effective 0.986703 after the relation-conditioned Band-3 loss) and slashing cof to 0.0930 Ir/cell at sl=80, sb=55; 8-row ORR scan+re-init 0.5385 Ir/cell, 417-chunk P_14 strip 37k, 9-prime split-CRT norms, 7-limb f-SRT batch; generous fixed-instance H3 caps 0.00116/0.00076/10.80/1.00 with plain-sparse 4-vec Z[omega] block Wiedemann (1024,35) and 5-SM shifted sigma-basis; 62-row LB=59 pure k=1 zero-retry Boole + Wald i.i.d. fresh-e b_best2 boot, boot=[180,76,12,1], Phi_tree=0.443477<=0.60, c_det_one=427, E[runs/log]<=1.796870, b3_skip=0.0129254430 in the descent miss_side; unified meter t_run=2^112) recovers x from z=g^x in GT w.p. >=0.39 and expected work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^86.808653360 <= 2^85.450205160 units (C=20,000 Ir; strictly expected), under declared exploratory premises H1, H2 (including the scoped Band-3 tier-node sub-premise), H3, H5, H-EA, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-SEP (proof.md §6, RANK-BRIDGE.md, ADAPTIVE.md). Gate K=7194258965782588261; opened-run success >=0.999996 via FIX-U; finite prototypes are scoped evidence, not proofs. The 15-row ledger and the derived Band-3 loss bound are checked live by audit_bn_cm.py (30/30).

experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verifier for the bn254-gt-dlp package bn254-v19-band3c (30/30 checks): algebra and CRT, exact FD, NTT and SRT kernels, split-CRT norms, P_14 strip, Band-2 apply and list builders, Band-2 SB-enter x4, Band-3 tau-orbit 12D lattice bucket-sieve (128.5KiB SQRT16, exact 6-to-1 bijection incl. K_2, Tier-1 SHIFT=24 + umulh + Q48 finite-diff AND Tier-2 fallback removed (gate failure aborts; relation-conditioned Band-3 loss 0.0129254430 charged in the retention and as evaluate_descent b3_skip) + non-charged Tier-2 prototype/witness diagnostic + delta=999/1000 LLL bound, input-uniform p<2^60 LLL bound, 36 unbiased hit-weighted production orbits, lx2=60 Stage-B 0-LP & sl=80 SWAR checks, padded table RAM), 8-row scan+re-init, Bareiss 12D LLL bounds, descent lattices and ECM ladder, ADAPTIVE.md diagnostics, H3 ladder and genuine-vs-synthetic filter calibration, unplanted 5-SM BW, 15-row gt-dlp ledger, relation-conditioned Band-3 loss lemma (phi_max, E[k_B3], union bound, marked-series cross-check, wiring), FIX-U and gate K. Optional parts: sensitivity, full, filtsim, hx.
